Mackenzie Scott released a serialized dystopian novel on Substack featuring eccentric presidential leaders and surreal territorial clashes.

The Bright Side:
Unfiltered creative freedom allows an author to write entirely outside commercial pressures.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing private self-expression (WHAT) with public literary merit (WHO). The project is an unedited billionaire diary disguised as a national allegory.

Social Physics Analysis:
Using boundless personal wealth to bypass editorial friction creates a closed echo chamber. Instead of a collaborative artistic dialogue, it projects eccentric inner fantasies onto a fictional political canvas.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Unfettered capital bypasses editorial reality checks, producing insular eccentricity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Unlimited wealth enables authors to bypass traditional gatekeeping and publish directly.
The Unavoidable Lie: Unfiltered personal whims do not automatically constitute profound political literature.
